english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for forming a mental image or envisioning something.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for forming a picture or idea in your mind.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for imagining or envisioning something.
Use this specifically for conceiving or imagining something in the mind rather than developing a concrete idea.
Use this for the mental-imagining part of “suppose,” when asking someone to picture or imagine something.
Use 想像 when fancy means forming a mental picture or imagining something.

examples.english: You can't imagine how scared I was then.
examples.traditional: 你想像唔到我當時幾咁驚。
examples.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 zoeng6 m4 dou2 ngo5 dong1 si4 gei2 gam3 geng1

examples.english: When I think about moving to the seaside, I can envisage hearing the waves every morning.
examples.traditional: 一諗起搬去海邊住，我就想像到每日朝早都聽住海浪聲。
examples.jyutping: jat1 nam2 hei2 bun1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 zyu6 ngo5 zau6 soeng2 zoeng6 dou3 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 teng1 zyu6 hoi2 long6 seng1

examples.traditional: 我可以想像到嗰個畫面。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 soeng2 zoeng6 dou3 go2 go3 waa6 min6

examples.english: I really can't conceive of him running that fast.
examples.traditional: 我真係想像唔到佢可以跑咁快。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 zoeng6 m4 dou2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 paau2 gam3 faai3

examples.english: Suppose you imagine what would happen if there were no electricity.
examples.traditional: 你想像吓，如果冇電會點？
examples.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 zoeng6 haa5 jyu4 gwo2 mou5 din6 wui5 dim2

examples.english: Fancy yourself living by the sea.
examples.traditional: 你想像下自己住喺海邊。
examples.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 zoeng6 haa5 zi6 gei2 zyu6 hai2 hoi2 bin1
